name: messenger-testimonial
title: Messenger Testimonial
blurb: Animated chat interface showing testimonial messages with typing indicator and…
description: Full-screen messenger-style testimonial display with messages appearing sequentially with typing indicator between them. Messages are clickable to show emoji reactions. Includes sender avatars, names, timestamps, customer stats, and live…
use_when: Hero sections where a chat/conversation aesthetic for testimonials creates engagement and relatability.
avoid_when: When text needs to be skimmable — sequential reveal and animations make quick reading difficult.
a11y: Message animations and typing indicators run continuously; no prefers-reduced-motion guard. Reaction interaction is click-only (no keyboard support). Stats text is readable.
